assertion.statement: Simultaneous global/local dense models and polynomial-forms control remain valid for W=D times the primes not dividing D, allowing fixed prime powers.
assertion.objects: Ordinary prime majorants, Artin-restricted functions f_j,b, centered functions g_j,b, and normalized bounded models on Z/nZ.
assertion.hypotheses: D and E are fixed, W=E times a primorial for sufficiently large v, residues are units, and the polynomial system has fixed complexity.
assertion.quantifiers: Every allowed residue and polynomial in the stated coefficient bounds; every required finite global and local order.
assertion.parameter_range: The source ranges M0,M1,J,A and rho in the fixed-field polynomial-count proof.
assertion.uniformity: The same bounded model handles global and local norms; fixed model bound must not grow with v,n or the residue.
assertion.constants: Small-prime local factors are excluded by the unit residue, other prime factors are unchanged, and fixed E is absorbed by coefficient bounds.
assertion.normalizations: Published squarefree-primorial statements supply a proof to adapt, not a literal theorem application to this W. Theorem 9 is independent of W.
assertion.exceptional_cases: All prime factors of E lie below v eventually. No uniformity in a growing field or growing fixed factor is asserted.
assertion.limit_order: Fix the field and complexities first, choose the small exponent, then v, then the length; use the displayed slow diagonal.

assertion.statement: The horizontal Taylor identities are exact in the vector groups before rational/small coordinate removal and remain exact after passage to the covering lattice.

assertion.hypotheses: The old identities hold modulo the horizontal lattice; that lattice is the image of Gamma intersect G_(i,1); horizontal Taylor coefficients are homomorphisms.
assertion.quantifiers: Every retained h and each of the finitely many weights 1 through m.
assertion.parameter_range: The regularized representation and its finite sequence of rational and small coordinate removals.
assertion.uniformity: Internal choices and the existing dense-subfamily bounded-choice rule retain the required common standard data.
assertion.constants: M is a common standard positive integer with all remaining generator Mth powers in Gamma-prime. Dividing the fixed lifts by M exactly cancels this multiplication.
assertion.normalizations: Right multiplication by the Gamma-valued polynomial preserves the same quotient orbit; a fixed product order is used without assuming commutativity.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Small and rational coordinates use their fixed small and rational lifts; linear petals use the real bracket-linear lift. Equality merely modulo the old lattice is insufficient.
assertion.limit_order: Normalize before removals, use the same real lifts during removals and cover scaling, and then fix finite cover/period data on a dense internal family.
